meta.title: Stop auto awarding
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the existing live RFQ with auto awarding enabled on its summary page.
Enable the required eRFX project setting for the case.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu, choose Disable Auto Awarding, and complete its confirmation flow.
Verify the stage header confirms that auto awarding is disabled and awarding is manual.
